chunks.text: AIS mismatches are reconciliation flags — not evidence of evasion. Users should reconcile with CAS, broker P&L, and Form 26AS before filing.

For CA review packs, list each mismatch with amount, AIS reference, suggested evidence, and whether the item is self-correctable or needs a professional position. Never label a mismatch as tax evasion.

TDS shown in Form 26AS but missing in books (or vice versa) should be traced to challans and deductors before advance-tax planning. Instruction-only Action Cards can list follow-ups; CAPSTONE does not file rectifications.
